export {
  Menubar,
  MenubarCheckboxItem,
  MenubarContent,
  MenubarGroup,
  MenubarItem,
  MenubarLabel,
  MenubarMenu,
  MenubarPortal,
  MenubarRadioGroup,
  MenubarRadioItem,
  MenubarSeparator,
  MenubarShortcut,
  MenubarSub,
  MenubarSubContent,
  MenubarSubTrigger,
  MenubarTrigger,
} from './menubar'
export { MotionMenubarContent } from './motion-menubar'

const menubarSurfaceStyle =
  'z-50 max-h-(--gentleduck-menubar-content-available-height) origin-(--gentleduck-menubar-content-transform-origin) overflow-y-auto overflow-x-hidden rounded-md border bg-popover p-1 text-popover-foreground'

export const menubarContentStyle = `${menubarSurfaceStyle} min-w-48 shadow-md`

export const menubarSubContentStyle = `${menubarSurfaceStyle} min-w-32 shadow-lg`
